annotation.title_clean: A Model for Calculating Cost of Applying Electronic Governance and Robotic Process Automation to a Distributed Management System
annotation.title_en: A Model for Calculating Cost of Applying Electronic Governance and Robotic Process Automation to a Distributed Management System
annotation.summary_en: Short arXiv paper presenting a mathematical model for the cost of completing a task using electronic governance and software-based Robotic Process Automation in a distributed management hierarchy, treating bots as employees with skill-dependent costs. It has no governance or regulatory content and does not cover physical robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends an organizational-structure cost model to include bot employees alongside humans.
Cost per unit time depends on hierarchy depth, skill level and salary ratios.
Combined human-bot cost is a normalized weighted sum of per-employee costs.
Claims to be the first cost model for applying eGov and RPA in distributed management.
Notes challenges such as data security, privacy and investment needs.
